idea-plugin.name: Phantom AI Visualization
idea-plugin.description:
The agent sessions of Phantom AI Integration as an isometric pixel-art office: each project is a floor, each worktree a desk area with a rug and a name plate, each agent session a person at a desk (typing, waiting with a raised hand, holding a coffee, or asleep). Opens in the "AI Visualization" tool window (its stripe icon), or as the "AI Visualization" editor tab from Tools | Open AI Visualization. Uses only the public API dev.phantom.ai.api of Phantom AI Integration.

Claude is a trademark of Anthropic and Codex a trademark of OpenAI; the names only label the sessions. This plugin is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Anthropic or OpenAI.

action.description: Show the agent sessions as a pixel-art office
